description:
Maintainer (2026-10-13): the pages that present results are hard to scan. examples/README.md holds two tables whose cells run to 300 characters of mixed numbers, conditions and guidance; docs/verdict.md's Workload results tables carry nine columns before the verdict is visible; the snapshot the runner prints is in alphabetical order with the verdict in the fourth column.

Do: lead every results page with a compact scoreboard (verdict mark first, then the job, the speedup over the best Elixir and against the package's NIF, one short note), sorted by verdict and speedup, from the 2026-10-13 quiet snapshot. Move the per-example prose (what was tried, traps, crossovers, guidance) below the scoreboard into one short block per example, trimmed of the loaded-run number ranges the snapshot supersedes. Make the runner's --snapshot table print in the same order with the same marks, so the next refresh drops in. Keep the measurement rules and the verdict rules where they are.

Done when: a reader finds the good, marginal and poor results on each page without reading a cell, the numbers on the pages are the snapshot's, and mix ci is green.
title: Results pages: scoreboard first, verdict visible at a glance
